name: CP-72 2713

paper.title: The big sibling of AU Mic: a cold dust-rich debris disk around CP-72 2713 in the beta Pic moving group

notes: 1.33mm ALMA Atacama Compact Array (7-m, ~7.4x5.5 arcsec beam) continuum detection, SNR~5.7; the disk is only moderately/marginally resolved as an extended blob at this coarse ACA resolution, not spatially resolved into a ring in the image itself -- ring geometry (peak radius ~140 au) is inferred from uv-plane visibility modelling, not directly visible by eye in the CLEAN image. Outstandingly large and dust-rich (24 Myr old K7/M0 member of the beta Pic moving group), motivating the 'big sibling of AU Mic' comparison in the paper title.
